title: Milton Hershey Comes Home to Lancaster After Two Failed Businesses
conflicts: Dates agree (Philadelphia 1876-1882, New York 1883-1886, Lancaster 1886) and the $1 million sale price agrees between the Hershey Community Archives and the NPS landmark nomination. They differ on who helped in 1886 (Archives: Lebkicher, mother and Aunt Mattie, a cashier's personal guarantee; NPS: a loan from a friend, a pushcart, a bank loan) and on later Philadelphia addresses and a Chicago venture; the story follows the Archives and omits the disputed details. Wikipedia's 1883 caramel start is not used.
notes: Told as one episode, the 1886 homecoming, with the two failures as background. NPS nomination is a scanned PDF that loads but fails the name check; four Hershey Archives pages and City Cast Philly pass. Funding marked bootstrapped (family loans, a bank loan; no outside investors).
